name: Achievements
description: Gamification framework: define achievement/badge config entities, award points on user milestones from code, and rank users on leaderboards.
project_description: The Achievements module offers the ability to create achievements and badges similar to systems seen on gaming consoles and location apps. For a Drupal site this could mean commenting a certain number of times, starting a forum topic, visiting every day of the week, or anything else that can be tracked and coded. Points are milestone-based rather than continuous: instead of 5 points every time a user posts a node, a milestone might award 20 points for posting 10 nodes. Each achievement has its own leaderboard, and a site-wide leaderboard ranks users by points (ties broken by who reached the total first). Achievements can be marked secret (placeholder text until unlocked) or invisible (hidden from the tab until unlocked), can carry unlocked/locked/secret badge images (module ships defaults), and unlock notifications fade in at the window corner. No achievements ship by default and creating them requires custom code that calls the module's API from your own entity/event hooks; see achievements.api.php for the hooks and example implementations.
